skills.name: raptorbt-core
skills.title: Core
skills.description: Engine concepts, the backtest lifecycle (data in, configuration, run, result) and the settings every run shares. Load this first.
load_when: Starting a RaptorBT project or choosing which API to use.
Learning the engine lifecycle: data in, config, run, result.
Setting capital, fees, slippage, fill timing or session length.

skills.name: raptorbt-analysis
skills.title: Analysis
skills.description: Exploring a price series before building a strategy: load bars once, evaluate expressions and statistics, and get a small true summary with a short handle that the next expression reads as a series. In Python (a Session) or from a shell (python -m raptorbt). The loop an agent follows from a task to evidence, what each flag means, and how a tested expression moves into a strategy unchanged.
load_when: Exploring a price series, an indicator or a signal before writing a strategy: what it looks like, where it is defined, whether it is flat.
Loading bars from a CSV, npz or npy file and evaluating an expression over them.
Researching a factor over many instruments: a panel, a cross-sectional rank or z-score, and its information coefficient, overlap-corrected t-statistic and gross long-short spread.
Evaluating an expression or a statistic and getting a small summary, then chaining its handle into the next expression.
Working from a shell with python -m raptorbt: eval, functions, describe, show, export, stats, skills.
Choosing which skills a task needs, or exporting the skills for another agent.
Moving an expression that was explored into a strategy with ctx.indicators.expr.

skills.name: raptorbt-strategy
skills.title: Strategy
skills.description: Writing a class-based strategy: the Strategy class, its lifecycle hooks, StrategyConfig parameters, the requirements manifest, the context and state, and running one or many strategies over the same data.
load_when: Writing a class-based strategy or choosing its hooks (on_init, on_start, on_bar, on_fill, on_stop).
Giving a strategy parameters (StrategyConfig, param bounds) or declaring what data it needs (requirements).
Running one strategy or many strategies over the same data.

skills.name: raptorbt-instruments
skills.title: Instruments
skills.description: Instrument definitions, asset classes, options and multi-instrument runs.
load_when: Trading several symbols or asset classes.
Defining futures lot size, tick size, multiplier, expiry and settlement.
Picking option strikes and expiries from a chain; pricing options, Greeks and implied volatility.
Building iron condors, straddles and other multi-leg option structures.
Market hours, trading sessions and holidays.
Trading option contracts while deciding on the index; building a synthetic chain and setting span_pct and exposure_pct for sold options.

skills.name: raptorbt-market-data
skills.title: Market data
skills.description: Bars, trades, quotes and order-book inputs, and tick-level features.
load_when: Preparing OHLCV arrays, trade ticks, quotes and order-book depth.
Handling timestamps, bar_stamp, bar open versus close stamps and ordering.
Checking what a strategy can see at an event (no lookahead).
Computing tick features or running tick-level simulation.

skills.name: raptorbt-subscriptions
skills.title: Subscriptions
skills.description: Declaring which streams and bar histories a strategy receives.
load_when: Subscribing a strategy to a symbol's trades, quotes or order books.
Subscribing to 5 minute, hourly or daily bars of a symbol.
Reading closed-bar history and the last quote or book with ctx.data.

skills.name: raptorbt-timeframes
skills.title: Timeframes
skills.description: Multi-timeframe aggregation and composite bars.
load_when: Combining 1m, 5m, 15m, hourly or daily data.
Turning 1 minute bars into 5, 15 or 60 minute bars, or into daily bars.
Building bars from ticks: time, tick-count, volume, value or Renko bars.
Anchoring bars at the market open; resampling, aggregating and bar grids.
Choosing which edge of a bar a boundary record belongs to.

skills.name: raptorbt-indicators
skills.title: Indicators
skills.description: Built-in vectorised and streaming indicators.
load_when: Computing SMA, EMA, RSI, ATR, MACD, Bollinger bands, ADX, VWAP or Supertrend.
Registering a streaming indicator on a strategy and waiting for warm-up.
Writing a custom indicator, or an indicator on a higher timeframe.

skills.name: raptorbt-expressions
skills.title: Expressions
skills.description: Writing a signal as one formula (close > sma(close, 200)), as text or from Python operators, and evaluating it over whole columns or one bar at a time with the same numbers. Covers unknown values (NaN and Kleene logic), warm-up, no-lookahead and the function list.
load_when: Writing a condition or derived series as one formula, as text or from Python operators.
Evaluating a formula over a stored history and bar by bar with identical numbers.
Looking up which expression functions exist, their warm-up and how they treat unknown values.

skills.name: raptorbt-statistics
skills.title: Statistics
skills.description: Statistical tests and fits over arrays for research: stationarity, cointegration, memory (Hurst), GARCH volatility, Markov regimes, HAC t-statistics, overfitting (PBO, SPA), factors, event studies, trading cost, parameter surfaces and a data audit. Which test answers which question, how many observations it needs, what it refuses and which results are not causal.
load_when: Choosing a test for a research question (stationarity, cointegration, memory, volatility, regimes, edge, overfitting, factors, events, cost).
Checking whether a backtest result is distinguishable from zero, or was the best of many tries (HAC, PBO, SPA).
Auditing bars before a study, or telling a parameter plateau from a spike.
Reading a regime, volatility or cointegration result and knowing which parts are not causal.

skills.name: raptorbt-orders
skills.title: Orders
skills.description: Order construction and lifecycle: the typed order kinds, sizing forms, time in force, brackets, OCO links, modify and cancel, option structures, and the reasons an order is refused.
load_when: Submitting or managing orders: limit, stop, stop-limit, trailing, bracket, OCO, modify, cancel.
Implementing a stop-loss, target or time in force (day, gtd, ioc, fok).
Explaining why an order was rejected, or placing a multi-leg option structure.
Putting an ATR stop or target on an option leg: the premium or the index.

skills.name: raptorbt-execution
skills.title: Execution
skills.description: Where a strategy's orders go: the ExecutionAdapter protocol, requests and execution reports, the simulated and paper venues, how a venue's fills are booked as facts, the host's order check and order tags, and what differs between paper and the in-process matcher.
load_when: Connecting a strategy to a venue: writing an ExecutionAdapter, or turning a venue's messages into execution reports.
Understanding what a fill, cancel or replace report does to the book, including fills that breach a limit or arrive out of order.
Validating on PaperExecution before real money, or explaining why paper and a backtest differ.
Installing the host's order check or attaching tags to orders.

skills.name: raptorbt-portfolio
skills.title: Portfolio
skills.description: The account a strategy trades against: positions, cash, equity and free capital, netting and hedging, margin accounts, shared account groups, booked fixed-point money, and portfolio construction math.
load_when: Reading positions, cash, equity or free capital; netting versus hedging; margin versus cash accounts.
Running several strategies on one shared account (AccountSpec) or several instruments against one capital pool.
Booked money (exact minor units), or turning forecasts into target weights (optimizer, factor panels, rebalancing).

skills.name: raptorbt-risk
skills.title: Risk
skills.description: Risk limits, kill switches, margin models and position sizing helpers: what refuses an order, what halts a strategy, and how many lots to trade.
load_when: Capping order size, position, exposure, open positions, daily loss or drawdown; adding a kill switch.
Sizing a position in lots from capital, risk, volatility or margin.
Modelling margin, or measuring covariance and risk contributions.

skills.name: raptorbt-backtesting
skills.title: Backtesting
skills.description: Historical simulation: choosing a runner, configuring fills, fees, slippage and latency, expiry and corporate actions in a backtest, and keeping a run deterministic.
load_when: Running a historical simulation and choosing between single, basket, multi, pairs, options and spread runners.
Setting fees, exchange charges (fee_segment, RateCard), slippage, fill timing, latency or stochastic fills.
Expiry, settlement and corporate actions (splits, dividends) in a backtest; making a run deterministic.

skills.name: raptorbt-optimization
skills.title: Optimization
skills.description: Parameter sweeps, batch runs and Monte Carlo validation.
load_when: Sweeping parameters across many runs; grid and random designs.
Walk-forward testing, the deflated Sharpe ratio and avoiding overfitting.
Checking robustness with a bootstrap or a portfolio Monte Carlo.

skills.name: raptorbt-live-trading
skills.title: Live trading
skills.description: Running strategies on a pushed feed with LiveNode: arrival times, warm-up, adopted positions and corporate actions, the journal, checkpoint, restore, reconciliation and fencing, broker adapters and their conformance kit, percent and group exits, continuous futures, and the instruments a context answers for.
load_when: Driving a strategy from a live feed with LiveNode, on paper or against a broker.
Warming up, adopting positions an account already holds (signed seeds with posted margin) or declaring corporate actions on a node.
Making a process survive a crash: the journal, checkpoint, restore, reconcile, resume, resend and fencing.
Connecting Kite, Upstox or Dhan through raptorbt.adapters, or testing an adapter with the conformance kit.
Percent and group exits, continuous futures and rolls, ctx.instrument, ctx.option_chain and ctx.role on a node.

skills.name: raptorbt-results
skills.title: Results
skills.description: Performance analysis, trades and diagnostics.
load_when: Reading metrics, equity and drawdown curves, trades, orders and the full report.
Judging whether a result is trustworthy; why a Sharpe ratio looks huge (annualisation).
Reconciling a run: fees, P&L, drawdown, open trades.

skills.name: raptorbt-deployment
skills.title: Deployment
skills.description: What a host must provide and decide to run a validated strategy for real: admitting a strategy from its requirements manifest, resolving its roles into symbols, building the node with bindings, a venue adapter, a journal and an epoch, supervising it, recovering it, and what to verify before real money.
load_when: Moving a validated strategy toward paper or real money, or running strategies other people wrote.
Admitting a strategy from its requirements manifest: check_requirements, params_schema, requirements_hash, resolve and role bindings.
Deciding what a worker must hold: instruments, bindings, journal and fsync, epoch and fencing, warm-up history, health and heartbeat.
Writing the recovery runbook, or the checklist of what to verify before live trading with real money.
Pinning versions and the once-a-day release check.

skills.name: raptorbt-troubleshooting
skills.title: Troubleshooting
skills.description: Structured errors by symptom: how to read a RaptorBT error, the codes a run, an order, a live node, a recovery and an adapter raise or report, how to read a journal, the mistakes that recur across skills, and the engine gaps known today.
load_when: A call raised a RaptorBT error: read code, parameter, valid and skill, then find the code by symptom.
An order was rejected, a run was refused, or results look wrong.
A live node raised fenced, recovering, replay_diverged, node_poisoned, venue_unavailable or journal_failed, or an adapter reported unconfirmed or session_expired.
Reading a journal to reconstruct what happened to an order.
Checking the known engine gaps before relying on a behaviour.
